headline: CCI approves Adani Energy Solutions' acquisition of Intellismart Infrastructure equity shares
hook: Adani Energy clears smart meter hurdle
summary: The Competition Commission of India has approved Adani Energy Solutions' proposed acquisition of equity share capital in Intellismart Infrastructure. Intellismart operates in the smart metering infrastructure space, which is expanding rapidly under government utility modernization programs. Adani Energy Solutions expands its footprint in the power transmission and smart metering sector through this transaction. Indian retail investors tracking Adani group utilities and power infrastructure plays should monitor how this consolidation impacts execution timelines.
why_it_matters: Expands Adani's smart metering infrastructure footprint.

Retail investors should note that these projections are based on long-term capacity expansion and policy tailwinds.
why_it_matters: Power utility stocks may see increased buying interest following analyst upgrades.
winners_losers: JSW Energy, Adani Energy, NTPC gain

headline: Adani Energy Solutions reports a 28 percent drop in smart meter installations in H1 FY27 due to consumer resistance and state-level hurdles
hook: Consumer pushback slows Adani's smart metering rollout
summary: Adani Energy Solutions installed 1.3 million smart meters during the July-September quarter, down from 1.8 million in the same period last year. The decline is attributed to consumer resistance and bureaucratic hurdles across states. For Indian retail investors, this slowdown impacts the execution timeline of a major revenue-generating government infrastructure scheme.

why_it_matters: Execution delays hit revenue growth for power transmission and smart meter players.

This performance reflects growth in its power transmission and distribution segments. The results highlight the company's ability to scale operations in the utility sector.
whats_next: Market reaction in the next trading session.

headline: Adani Energy Solutions reports a 148% jump in Q2 net profit to ₹1,323 crore

Retail investors tracking the Adani group should note the sharp top-line and bottom-line expansion.
